findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_authentication, check_ai_shopper_readiness · Private data: estimate_automation_roi, check_app_security, deep_scan_app, check_email_authentication, check_ai_shopper_readiness, submit_mcp_server, claim_mcp_server · Public sink: estimate_automation_roi, get_store_speed_index, check_app_security, list_field_kits, check_email_authentication, submit_mcp_server · Destructive: ask_7it.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_authentication, check_ai_shopper_readiness · Private data: estimate_automation_roi, check_app_security, deep_scan_app, check_email_authentication, check_ai_shopper_readiness, submit_mcp_server, claim_mcp_server · Public sink: estimate_automation_roi, get_store_speed_index, check_app_security, list_field_kits, check_email_authentication, submit_mcp_server · Destructive: ask_7it

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
